text:
DeployBot: initiating rollout v4.5.0 -> prod. Canary: 4% traffic. Observability alert: embeddings-async p95 increased ~45% on a subset of canary hosts. Autorevert suppressed (human review). Please ack and recommend rollback scope.
Aria: ack — I see the spike on two canary nodes, route-scoped to embeddings-async.
Ben: digging into logs now. Seeing a burst of KV-cache evictions + retry storms; also some slow disk IO on the canary hosts. text-gen routes unaffected.
SreKris: thanks. Given the route isolation, I recommend a split-traffic fallback (route-level override) instead of a full release revert to keep other improvements live.
OpsMira: note: policy requires Ops + SRE 2FA for overrides during change window. Cutoff for automated revert actions: 3525009910. I can run the override once SreKris approves.
ProductFay: freeze release notes until we confirm. If we pin the route, prepare a short customer advisory for enterprise seats and dedicated pools.
CS_Jen: I have the enterprise list ready. Will wait on the advisory copy.
SreKris: approving route override. OpsMira please execute the pin with a 30m expiry so we can monitor.
OpsMira: executing now.
OpsMira: /run redwoodctl route override --scope route --route embeddings-async --target-version v4.4.2 --duration 30m --reason "canary p95 regression - split fallback"
DeployBot: action accepted: embeddings-async route overridden to v4.4.2 by OpsMira at 3525009889. Canary traffic to v4.5.0 for embeddings-async set to 0%.
Aria: monitoring — p95 back to baseline within ~90s. 502s dropped to baseline. Nice containment. :thumbsup:
Ben: opened revert PR in case code rollback is needed (repo@commit x123abc) and linked to incident.
ProductFay: adding release metadata: "embeddings-async routed to v4.4.2 due to canary tail latency regression; investigating." Freezing other release notes.
CS_Jen: advisory draft: "We routed embeddings traffic to a previously stable runtime after a performance regression was observed during canary. No data loss. Engineering investigating; will update." Ready to send on PM approval.
SreKris: keeping alerts on for 45m; if p95 > 1.5x baseline or errors spike we'll consider extending override or escalating to full revert.
OpsMira: override expires at 3525010069 unless extended. I'll extend if telemetry needs it.
DeployBot: incident archived: INC-2026-051. Logs and events attached to the incident record.
Aria: filing postmortem starter and assigning owners to runtime + infra teams.
ProductFay: please send advisory, CS_Jen. PM will review and approve.
CS_Jen: sent to enterprise list after PM review.
SreKris: closing watch for now; will reopen if telemetry regresses.
DeployBot: thread closed by OpsMira at 3525009905.
